paper.title: Nitrogen-doped porous carbons with high performance for hydrogen storage

defaults.verified_by: Agent B: 262 cells verified, 0 disputes (full Table 1 re-transcribed independently; no swaps, HC precursor correctly excluded)

notes.porevol: bet_surface_area_m2_g is the total BET area (N2, 77 K, P/Po 0.01-0.2); micropore_surface_area_m2_g and micropore_volume_cm3_g are t-plot values (Table 1 parenthetical columns, footnotes a and b); total_pore_volume_cm3_g is a single-point value from the N2 amount adsorbed at P/Po ca. 0.995; pore_volume_method=t_plot describes the micropore volume
notes.psd: Table 1's pore-size column reports multiple NLDFT pore-size-distribution maxima per sample (footnote c), not a single average; average_pore_diameter_nm is therefore not recorded
notes.type: uptake_type unspecified (exact-word rule): the paper never uses excess, absolute or excessive for any quantity; total appears only in total pore volume and in the P1/2 normalisation, not as a label on these uptake values
notes.method: 1-bar isotherms by a volumetric method (Quantachrome Autosorb-1, 0-1 bar, 77 K); 20-bar uptake by a volumetric PCI unit (Advanced Materials Corp., 0-20 bar, 77 K); H2 99.999%; samples evacuated 12 h at 250 C before N2 sorption; sample mass and blank/calibration not stated
notes.ncon: nitrogen content by elemental analysis (Vario III); N speciation by XPS (Fig 3); the Table 1 N/C ratio has no schema field and is noted here only
notes.abstractconf: the abstract states SBET, pore-volume and N-content ranges that differ slightly from Table 1 (e.g. SBET 1362-3009 vs Table 1 1394-2919; N 0.56-6.53 vs 0.53-6.50); Table 1 is the primary source and is recorded

S1.label: PC-2-600
S1.material_description: PC-2-600: nitrogen-doped porous carbon from hydrothermally carbonised chitosan, KOH activation at KOH/hydrochar weight ratio 2, 600 C under Ar; nitrogen is precursor-derived (chitosan)
S1.activation_method: KOH chemical activation, KOH/hydrochar weight ratio 2, 600 C under Ar, 3 C/min, 1 h hold
S1.purification_method: washed twice with HCl (10 wt%), then distilled water to neutral pH, dried 105 C
